classes.description: MfgCalendar — 制造日历。定义工厂的班次排程、制造日期和财会期间。包含多个 CalendarShift 条目，每条记录班次起止时间(ShiftStart/ShiftEnd)、制造日期、财会周期(年/季/月/周)和排程信息。Factory 和 WorkCenter 通过 USES_MFG_CALENDAR 引用。 【Swagger】Schema: MfgCalendarEntity；来源文件: MfgCalendars.json；API: /api/MfgCalendars。

classes.description: CalendarShift — 日历班次条目（MfgCalendar 的子实体）。记录制造日历中每个班次的起止时间(ShiftStart/ShiftEnd)、制造日期(CalendarDate)、财会期间（年/季/月/周）、非排程时间(isNonScheduledTime)，以及关联的班次类型(Shift)和班组(Team)。 【Swagger】Schema: CalendarShiftChanges；来源文件: MfgCalendars.json；API: /api/MfgCalendars。

properties.name: calendarDate
properties.description: 制造日期 【Swagger】Factories often have shift schedules that result in a shift starting work on one date and ending on another date; where 12 midnight is in the middle of the shift. For these factories, it is normal to have a concept of "Manufacturing Date" that enables any particular shift to fall entirely on one particular manufacturing day. A factory with shifts that start at 7am, 3pm, and 11pm will normally have a "Manufacturing Date" that begins on 11pm of the previous clock date, and ends at 11pm of the current clock date.
